# Copyright 2025 Intel Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# ARM64-native NEON and crypto (AES) tests. These are self-contained
# aarch64-only tests using <arm_neon.h>; they are skipped (no-op) on x86-64
# because the entire subdir is entered only under the aarch64 guard below.
# (The x86-64 counterpart of crypto coverage is the OpenSSL SHA test under
# tests/cpu/openssl, gated separately by ssl_link_type.)

if host_machine.cpu_family() == 'aarch64'
    # crypto_test.cpp uses vaeseq_u8 / vaesmcq_u8, which require the +crypto
    # target; neon_test.cpp uses baseline armv8.1-A NEON. A single march covers
    # both files.
    arm64_cpp_flags = [
        '-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto',
    ]

    arm64_tests = files(
        'neon_test.cpp',
        'crypto_test.cpp',
        # di/dt voltage-transient power virus ("版图三 瞬态故障动态激发").
        # Alternates NEON full-load bursts with yield stalls to induce voltage
        # droop and excite transient SDC on the SIMD/FMA path — the only
        # burst/stall power-virus in the suite. Built only on aarch64.
        'power_virus_dit.cpp',
        'sdc_test.cpp',
        # Integer Execution Unit SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (IEX 70%).
        # Full IEX opcode combination (add/sub/and/or/xor/mul/shift/clz/rbit/
        # rev) over high-Hamming operands with serial dependency, plus
        # carry-flag dependent adcs/sbcs/csel chains run twice to detect
        # non-deterministic flag-rename SDC — the opcode-mix and flag-rename
        # surfaces operand_space_arm/adcx/mrn_ never cover. Built only on
        # aarch64.
        'iex_operand_combo_arm.cpp',
        # Instruction-Fetch Unit SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (IFU 66%).
        # JIT-generated data-dependent indirect-branch (br) dispatch table
        # with a high-Hamming target permutation and padded blocks, to
        # torture the branch predictor / BTB / instruction-cache path that no
        # existing test targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'ifu_branch_target_arm.cpp',
        # Out-of-order execution SDC stress — coverage-weak unit (OoO 56%).
        # Pointer-chasing dependency chain, carry-dependent mixed ALU+memory
        # chain, RW-hazard interleave, and long dependent ALU chains to stress
        # the scheduler/ROB/rename under serial dependencies — the replay/
        # rename surface no existing test targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'ooo_dep_chain_arm.cpp',
        # LSU store-buffer/load-forwarding SDC stress — coverage-weak unit
        # (LSU 54%). Same-size forward at widths 1/2/4/8/16B and offsets
        # including the cache-line boundary, partial-store forwarding/merging,
        # store-after-load hazard, 128B cross-line forward, and strided
        # same-line forward — the forwarding datapath no existing memory test
        # targets. Built only on aarch64.
        'lsu_store_forward_arm.cpp',
        # L2 cache coherency/split-access SDC stress — coverage-weak unit
        # (L2C 40%). Adds cross-64B-line exclusive ldxr/stxr RMW, store-to-load
        # forwarding across the line boundary, dc-civac writeback probe, and a
        # 2x-L2 thrash sweep — the coherency/snoop/split surfaces that
        # memcpy_l2_cache_size never touches. Built only on aarch64.
        'l2c_cross_cache_line_arm.cpp',
        # MMU/TLB/PTW SDC stress — the coverage-weakest unit (MMU 20%). Adds
        # page-color aliasing (one physical page, many VAs), dual-TLB-lookup
        # cross-page and cross-cache-line split accesses, and a large-ASID
        # pressure sweep, none of which mmu_stress_arm exercises. Built only
        # on aarch64.
        'mmu_split_tlb_arm.cpp',
        # Floating-point/SIMD Unit byte-exact SDC stress (FSU 80% — highest
        # weak unit, but with a real gap: fma.cpp compares with a 1e-6
        # tolerance, so a 1-bit FSU SDC passes. This test is byte-exact
        # throughout: FMA over the full IEEE-754 special-value table, cross-
        # cache-line 128B NEON data path, single<->double widen/narrow, and
        # a high-Hamming dependent FMA chain, all compared bit-exact against
        # libm. Built only on aarch64.
        'fsu_byteexact_arm.cpp',
        # AGU throughput stress: 2 source loads + data-ALU + store/reload/
        # store chain (3 ldr + 2 str per element), maximizing address-
        # generation pressure. Rotation uses {add,eor,and,orr} — a different
        # composition than mrn_nuke_2src_alu's {add,sub,eor,and} — to test
        # rotation-composition robustness of the core-179 trigger recipe.
        # Dual-arch inline asm (x86 movq / aarch64 str-ldr), placed in the
        # ARM64 suite per the arm64 classification. Built only on aarch64.
        'agu_stress_2src.cpp',
        # NEON/vector-datapath port of the core-179 trigger recipe: 2 source
        # vector loads + rotating vector ALU {add,eor,and,orr} (uint64x2) +
        # back-to-back vector store/reload/store. The asm-guaranteed str q ->
        # ldr q pair (the compiler eliminates the intrinsic reload) makes it
        # discriminate whether the trigger recipe is bound to the scalar
        # ALU/L1D path or also fires on the SIMD datapath. Uses uint64x2_t
        # unconditionally, so it can only be built on aarch64.
        'neon_rot_2src.cpp',
        # movbe byte-swap SDC series (moved from tests/cpu/misc): the core-179
        # research testbed of the byte-swap round-trip trigger. movbe is the
        # baseline (bswap + store + bswap-back + compare), movbe_dump adds the
        # full dump on failure, and the 11 movbe_dump_probe_* variants remove
        # or vary one ingredient at a time (no-store, reload position, ...)
        # to localize the trigger. All portable __builtin_bswap32 (no arch
        # guards), classified ARM64-only with the rest of the core-179 probes.
        'movbe.cpp',
        'movbe_dump.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_a.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_b.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_c.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_d.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_e.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_f.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_g1.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_g2.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_h.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_x.cpp',
        'movbe_dump_probe_xn.cpp',
        # Scan-order variant of neon_rot_ldr_at_top (core-179 attribution):
        # even outer iterations sweep indices ascending, odd descending, so
        # the touch pattern at the corruption-concentrated first indices
        # (idx 0/1 of the 55-record dump campaign) differs from the parent's
        # fixed order. Strong idx-0/1 signal here too -> the signature
        # follows the buffer slots (address-local, e.g. same L1D set/way);
        # signature moves to the sweep seam / disappears -> it follows the
        # forward-progress position. Same 3rd-ldr-at-top + 2-src loads +
        # rotating vector ALU {add,eor,and,orr} + back-to-back str/str
        # skeleton otherwise. uint64x2_t / aarch64 inline asm only — built
        # only on aarch64.
        'neon_rot_ldr_at_top_rowmajor.cpp',
    )

    arm64_tests_lib = static_library(
        'tests_arm64',
        arm64_tests,
        build_by_default: false,
        include_directories: [
            framework_incdir,
        ],
        dependencies: [
            boost_dep,
        ],
        cpp_args: [
            debug_c_flags,
            default_cpp_warn,
            default_cpp_flags,
            march_generic_flags,
            arm64_cpp_flags,
        ],
    )

    # SVE full-vector-length (sve512_fma family) SDC stress tests. Compiled
    # in their own static library because <arm_sve.h> intrinsics require the
    # +sve target, while the tests_arm64 baseline stays armv8.1-a+crc+crypto:
    # enabling +sve for the whole library could let GCC auto-vectorize the
    # NEON tests into SVE instructions, which would SIGILL on SVE-less CPUs
    # such as this Kunpeng 920. Every test probes HWCAP_SVE first thing in
    # test_init and returns a clean EXIT_SKIP on SVE-less CPUs, so their SVE
    # codegen only ever executes on SVE-capable hardware. Built only on
    # aarch64.
    arm64_sve_lib = static_library(
        'tests_arm64_sve',
        files(
            # workload 4: gather/FMA/scatter round-trip over a permuted
            # index table, byte-exact vs a scalar golden indexing through
            # the SAME indirection.
            'sve512_gather_scatter_arm.cpp',
            # workload 1: 512-step serial svmla_f64_x dependency chain over
            # high-Hamming finite operands (|x| <= 2, so the chain can never
            # overflow to Inf/NaN), byte-exact vs a scalar fma() golden
            # recomputed with the identical operation order.
            'sve512_f64_chain_arm.cpp',
            # workload 2: same serial FMLA chain over the IEEE-754 special
            # table (NaN/sNaN/Inf/+-0/+-1), compared by category per
            # fsu_byteexact_arm precedent — a category change is always a
            # failure; NaN payloads are not byte-compared because IEEE 754
            # does not require deterministic NaN payload propagation.
            'sve512_f64_special_arm.cpp',
            # workload 3: the same serial FMLA chain structure at f32 width
            # (svmla_f32_x), exercising the 16-lane f32 FMA/predicate
            # datapath at full 512-bit width, byte-exact vs a scalar
            # fmaf() golden recomputed with the identical operation order.
            'sve512_f32_chain_arm.cpp',
            # SVD-format variant of workload 1: same serial svmla_f64_x
            # chain, but the operand streams are walked through a 16x16
            # nested block traversal (BDCSVD-style block-of-matrix access)
            # over an SVD-scale allocation (300*300*512*VL elements per
            # stream, ~2.7 GiB each at a 512-bit VL). The per-iteration
            # touched set (~24 MB, 5.76 MB step stride) overflows L2 and
            # pressures L3/TLB — the first of eigen_svd_cdouble_sve's
            # SVD-only trigger paths (working set beyond L2).
            'sve512_f64_chain_svd.cpp',
            # SVD-format variant of workload 2: the same SVD-scale block
            # traversal over the IEEE-754 special-value table (64-step
            # chain), compared per lane by category (fsu_byteexact_arm
            # precedent). Allocation: 300*300*64*VL per stream (~360 MB
            # each at a 512-bit VL).
            'sve512_f64_special_svd.cpp',
            # SVD-format variant of workload 3: the same SVD-scale block
            # traversal at f32 width (svmla_f32_x, 16-lane f32 datapath),
            # byte-exact vs a scalar fmaf() golden. Allocation:
            # 300*300*512*VL f32 elements per stream (~2.7 GiB each at a
            # 512-bit VL).
            'sve512_f32_chain_svd.cpp',
            # SVD-format variant of workload 4: gather/FMA/scatter
            # round-trip over a 2-D 16x16 block-permuted index table
            # (90000 f64 elements, ~2.9 MB working set across src/dst),
            # byte-exact vs a scalar golden indexing through the SAME
            # indirection.
            'sve512_gather_scatter_svd.cpp',
            # SCF/stencil axis-kernel SDC trigger replicator — verbatim
            # port of the cn23154 NUMA3 field reproducer (example.cpp):
            # svdup_f64(coeff[r]) coefficient loads (ld1rd replicate-load
            # codegen under clang), dual-vector svmla_x chain, full unroll,
            # memory-resident loop counter, per-iteration VA[63:48] canary.
            # One deliberate semantic fix vs the standalone, per the field
            # diagnosis (5 bit-identical reruns): the expected value is
            # 1.5*iterations*(j+1) (RADIUS=6), the stale RADIUS=4 formula
            # iterations*(j+1) was a software false positive.
            'sve512_stencil_axis_arm.cpp',
        ),
        build_by_default: false,
        include_directories: [
            framework_incdir,
        ],
        dependencies: [
            boost_dep,
        ],
        cpp_args: [
            debug_c_flags,
            default_cpp_warn,
            default_cpp_flags,
            march_generic_flags,
            '-march=armv8.2-a+sve',
        ],
    )

    sandstone_tests += [
        arm64_tests_lib,
        arm64_sve_lib,
    ]
endif

**Created:** 2026-09-16
**Status:** complete
**Goal:** 通过并行 subagent 研究本项目源码、docs/paper 下 33 篇 SDC 论文 + 蒸馏综合、docs/cpu/cn23154.md 这颗 CPU 的特性与已知故障签名、SVE/SME/SME2 ISA 与生态、以及本仓全部测试用例,产出一份**有证据支撑的测试增强提案**(research-notes/ENHANCEMENT_PROPOSAL.md):如何增强/新增测试以最大化激发 ARM64 服务器芯片浮点向量单元的 SDC。本轮只做研究 + 提案,不写代码(实施走后续 writing-plans 流程)。

- 框架 simd-arm.conf 有 "sme" 字样但无 cpu_feature_sme(需查明是什么)

echo "== FDMLA with .d operands assembled OK above? The last attempt had no error line shown - re-verify explicitly =="; printf '.arch armv9-a+sve2
fdmla z0.d, p0/m, z1.d, z2.d
' | as -o /dev/null - && echo FDMLA_D_AS_OK || echo FDMLA_D_AS_FAIL
echo "== FDMLA proper per ARM ARM: FDMLA Zda.S, Pg/M, Zn.S, Zm.S — f32 to f64? No: FDMLA is .S dest with .S srcs (double-single). Check =="; printf '.arch armv9-a+sve2
fdmla z0.s, p0/m, z1.s, z2.s
' | as -o /dev/null - && echo FDMLA_S_AS_OK || echo FDMLA_S_AS_FAIL
echo "== which SVE2 FP intrinsics DOES gcc12 arm_sve.h have: grep the header =="; grep -o "svfdmla_[a-z0-9_]*\|svmlalb_[a-z0-9_]*\|svmlalt_[a-z0-9_]*\|svbfdot_[a-z0-9_]*\|svmlalb_lane[a-z0-9_]*" /usr/lib/gcc/aarch64-openEuler-linux/12/include/arm_sve.h | sort -u | head -20
echo "== clang 17 same grep =="; grep -o "svfdmla_[a-z0-9_]*\|svmlalb_f32\|svmlalt_f32\|svbfdot_f32" /usr/lib64/clang/17/include/arm_sve.h | sort -u | head

echo "== SME mova: immediate slice index, not w reg =="; printf '.arch armv9-a+sme\nsmstart za\nptrue p0.s\nzero {za}\nfmopa za0.s, p0/m, p0/m, z0.s, z1.s\nmova z2.s, p0/m, za0v.s[0]\nsmstop za\n' | as -o /dev/null - && echo SME_SEQ_IMM_OK || printf '.arch armv9-a+sme\nmova z2.s, p0/m, za0v.s[0]\n' | as -o /dev/null - 2>&1|head -2
echo "== SME full inline asm gcc, post-inc replaced by fixed offsets =="; cat > /tmp/smeasm2.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
void sme_mopa_chain(const float *a, const float *b, int n, float *out) {
    __asm__ volatile(
        "smstart za\n\t"
        "ptrue p0.s\n\t"
        "zero {za}\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "ld1w {z0.s}, p0/z, [%[a]]\n\t"
        "ld1w {z1.s}, p0/z, [%[b]]\n\t"
        "add %[a], %[a], #16\n\t"
        "add %[b], %[b], #16\n\t"
        "fmopa za0.s, p0/m, p0/m, z0.s, z1.s\n\t"
        "subs %w[n], %w[n], #4\n\t"
        "b.ne 1b\n\t"
        "mova z2.s, p0/m, za0v.s[0]\n\t"
        "st1w {z2.s}, p0/z, [%[o]]\n\t"
        "smstop za\n\t"
        : [a]"+r"(a), [b]"+r"(b), [n]"+r"(n)
        : [o]"r"(out)
        : "z0","z1","z2","p0","memory","cc");
}
EOF
gcc -march=armv9-a+sme -c /tmp/smeasm2.c -o /tmp/smeasm2.o && echo GCC_SME_ASM2_OK && objdump -d /tmp/smeasm2.o | grep -cE "smstart|fmopa|mova|zero"; echo "== clang =="; clang -march=armv9-a+sme -c /tmp/smeasm2.c -o /tmp/smeasm3.o && echo CLANG_SME_ASM2_OK

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 落地 research-notes/ENHANCEMENT_PROPOSAL.md 的全部 16 项提案(7 波次 19 任务):修复弱校验检测、新增 14 个 SVE/SVE2/SME/NEON 激发测试、簇锚定 campaign 脚本与诊断增强,最大化激发 ARM64 服务器芯片(cn23154 = HiSilicon 0xd22, SVE512)浮点向量单元的 SDC。

**Architecture:** 四层递进——W1 先修检测强度(容差→byte-exact、RNG 可重放、conf 修正);W2-W4 新增指令族测试(nt_reload 对准已知故障签名、FMMLA/跨精度/FCMLA/谓词/FPCR/gather 变体/双值域);W5-W6 campaign 脚本 + 诊断 + SVE di/dt 病毒 + mesh FP;W7 SME 前瞻。所有 SVE 类新测试沿用 sve512 家族已验证干净的模式(ACLE intrinsics + init 首行 getauxval 探测 + 标量同序 golden + 字节级比较),本机(Kunpeng 920 无 SVE)验证到「编译 + SVE 代码生成 + 干净 skip」,真实验证在 cn23154。

**Tech Stack:** meson + GCC 12.3(主机)/BiSheng clang 19.1.7(目标机);ACLE `<arm_sve.h>`;inline asm(GNU as 2.41 已验证语法);框架 RNG `random64()`;测试旋钮 `-O <test>.<knob>=<v>`。

## Global Constraints

- **one-patch-per-unit**:每个 Task = 恰好一个 commit,按顺序执行,不并行不合并。
- **分支**:`feat/sdc-excitation-enhancement-20260917`(自 main @ 901ca96d 创建),每 commit 验证后自动 push,**永不推 main**。
- **x86-64 非回归**:所有改动在 aarch64 守卫内(`#ifdef __aarch64__` / meson `host_machine.cpu_family() == 'aarch64'`);child_debug.cpp 的改动必须 `#ifdef __aarch64__` 包裹,x86 CR2 路径不动。

- **commit message 禁止 Co-Authored-By: Claude 结尾**(CLAUDE.md 覆盖默认行为)。

## 侦察结论(2026-09-17 实测,纠正研究笔记的四处假设)

1. **FDMLA 不可用**:binutils 2.41 不识别 `fdmla` 助记符,GCC 12/clang 17 均无 `svfdmla_*` intrinsic → 跨精度族改用实测可编译的 `svmlalb_f32/svmlalt_f32`(FP16→FP32)+ `svbfdot_f32`(BF16;`-march=armv9-a+sve2+bf16` 下 asm/intrinsic 双验证通过)。

input.command:
python3 <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys

# Pattern shared by fmatail*/fma_tail* (memcmp already, fix RNG+fprintf+atomic)
files = [
    'tests/cpu/fma/fma_tail_avx2.cpp', 'tests/cpu/fma/fma_tail_avx512.cpp',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_avx2.cpp', 'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_avx512.cpp',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_nested_avx2.cpp', 'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_nested_avx512.cpp',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_double_nested_avx2.cpp', 'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_double_nested_avx512.cpp',
]
for fn in files:
    s = open(fn).read()
    orig = s

    # 1. includes: drop <random>/<atomic>/<cstdio>
    s = s.replace('#include <atomic>\n', '')
    s = s.replace('#include <random>\n', '')
    s = s.replace('#include <cstdio>\n', '')

    # 2. RNG decl + distribution -> per-thread splitmix64 LCG seed from framework random64()
    #    match the decl block (mt19937 line + optional distribution line)
    s = re.sub(r'    std::mt19937 rng\(std::random_device\{\}\(\)\);\n(    std::uniform_real_distribution<\w+> dist\([^)]*\);\n)?',
               '    /* Deterministic per-thread operand generator: seeded once from the\n'
               '     * framework RNG (replayable via -s), advanced by a splitmix64 LCG. */\n'
               '    uint64_t seed = random64();\n', s)

    # 3. usages: dist(rng) -> bounded random values via helper
    #    Each file calls dist(rng) at several places; replace with fma_rand_bounded(&seed) for float,
    #    fma_rand_bounded_d(&seed) for double. Detect the distribution type from the file.
    is_double = 'uniform_real_distribution<double>' in orig
    helper = ('fma_rand_bounded_d' if is_double else 'fma_rand_bounded')
    s = re.sub(r'\bdist\(rng\)', f'{helper}(&seed)', s)

    # 4. remove static atomic iter + iteration counter line
    s = re.sub(r'\n    static std::atomic<uint64_t> iter\{0\};\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n\s*uint64_t iteration = iter\.fetch_add\(1, std::memory_order_relaxed\);\n', '\n', s)

    # 5. remove the per-iteration fprintf logging block (starts with color/printf decls, ends with fflush)
    #    Patterns: "const char *color ..." lines, the fprintf block, fflush line
    s = re.sub(r'\n        const char \*color = passed \? [^\n]*\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n        const char \*result_str = passed \? [^\n]*\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n        // ---- 输出日志[^\n]*\n', '\n', s)
    # remove consecutive fprintf(stderr,...) statements (possibly multi-line till ');')
    s = re.sub(r'\n        fprintf\(stderr,[^;]*?\);\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n        fflush\(stderr\);\n', '\n', s)
    # nested variants indent with 12 spaces inside group loop
    s = re.sub(r'\n            fprintf\(stderr,[^;]*?\);\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n            fflush\(stderr\);\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n            const char \*color = passed \? [^\n]*\n', '\n', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\n            const char \*result_str = passed \? [^\n]*\n', '\n', s)

    # 6. after failure check, we may have leftover blank runs; collapse 3+ newlines
    s = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', s)

    open(fn, 'w').write(s)
    print(f'{fn}: dist-> {helper}, fprintf removed: {orig.count("fprintf") - s.count("fprintf")}, dist calls replaced: {orig.count("dist(rng)")}')
PYEOF

input.command:
python3 <<'PYEOF'
# The golden assignment lines were eaten by the aggressive line filter. Restore them.
# Pattern: "// ---- 软件参考：使用标准库 fma...（正确舍入） ----" followed by an EMPTY for-loop body.
import re

files = {
    'tests/cpu/fma/fma_tail_avx2.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fma_tail_avx512.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_avx2.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_avx512.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_nested_avx2.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_nested_avx512.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_double_nested_avx2.cpp': 'fma',
    'tests/cpu/fma/fmatail_double_nested_avx512.cpp': 'fma',
}
for fn, fnname in files.items():
    s = open(fn).read()
    # empty golden loop: for (...) { } right after the 软件参考 comment — refill body
    pat = re.compile(r'(// ---- 软件参考[^\n]*\n)(        for \(int i = 0; i < VECTOR_SIZE; \+\+i\) \{\n)(        \}\n)')
    s2, n = pat.subn(r'\1\2            sw_ref[i] = %s(a[i], b[i], c[i]);\n\3' % fnname, s)
    # nested variants indent 12
    pat2 = re.compile(r'(            for \(int i = 0; i < VECTOR_SIZE; \+\+i\) \{\n)(            \}\n)')
    s3, n2 = pat2.subn(r'\1                sw_ref[i] = %s(a[i], b[i], c[i]);\n\2' % fnname, s2)
    open(fn, 'w').write(s3)
    filled = s3.count('sw_ref[i] = ')
    print(f'{fn}: golden refs restored: {filled}')
PYEOF

  deterministic per-thread LCG seeded from the framework RNG (random64()) —
  failures are now replayable via -s; previously unreproducible.

  fprintf + color codes + static atomic counter) removed from the hot loop
  (ITHICA: execution context is the dominant predictor — even one no-op in

  random source changed.
